protocol.selection_ties: earliest epoch; epoch0 identity map included
protocol.initialization: last linear weight and bias zero
protocol.frozen: REVE, original blur projection, B recovery, image adapter; frozen heads always eval
protocol.loss: one-direction CE clean + CE native adapter blur, equal weights; image-only L2 normalization; temperature1
protocol.augmentation: none during calibration; one real trial per image
protocol.source_route: calibrator bypassed during ordinary source training
protocol.inference: pointwise; no target support, target identity, target labels or test-time updates
protocol.aggregation: all valid trials of each subject/image; mean raw predictions after inference
protocol.primary_comparison: identity versus base within each pool, seed and target subject

directions.seen: fit one source-person trial per image from S3--S10, evaluate S1 and S2

protocol.interpretation: bidirectional development pilot; not a full episodic meta-learning reproduction

statistical_unit: subject; seeds are paired repeats, not independent subjects
